title: New hepatitis surveillance report shows strengthened public health cooperation with EU candidate countries
summary: The report brings together surveillance data on hepatitis A from EU candidate countries.

title: Risk to general population remains very low following fourth imported Ebola case in Europe
summary: A healthcare worker based in the DRC who tested positive for Bundibugyo virus on 29 September is being medically evacuated to the Netherlands to receive specialised care.

title: EU-led assessment to Albania will strengthen cross-sector response to antimicrobial resistance
summary: An EU-led mission of experts to Albania this week will identify priority gaps, define areas for further action and support the strengthening of national responses to antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in the country.

title: First public health emergency preparedness assessments across Europe show both commitment and recurring challenges
summary: The first cycle of Public Health Emergency Preparedness Assessments (PHEPAs) coordinated by the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) has shown a strong commitment to emergency preparedness across Europe, with a number of common challenges remaining.

title: ECDC to deploy experts as Ebola cases emerge in Kenya and Nigeria
summary: Following the emergence of Ebola disease in Kenya and Nigeria, and with the situation in the DRC remaining serious, ECDC is increasing its efforts to support investigations and local response by sending a team of ECDC experts to Nigeria.

title: Importation of Ebola cases to Kenya and Nigeria: ECDC assesses the threat
summary: With cases of Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus recently detected in Kenya and Nigeria, ECDC reiterates the low risk for Europe while highlighting the need for preparedness.

title: Respiratory infections season
summary: As the colder months approach in Europe, respiratory infections including influenza, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infections, COVID-19, pneumococcal disease and others can lead to serious illness and increase the burden on healthcare services throughout Europe.

title: Protect yourself and others during the cold season

title: Severely ill patient in France becomes first ever human infected with Shamonda virus
summary: The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) is carefully monitoring the situation after the French authorities announced the first ever reported human infection with Shamonda virus (SHAV), a disease that has until now only affected animals.

title: Ebola disease: Multi-country outbreak 2026
summary: Since May 2026, an Ebola virus disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus has been ongoing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).
